questionText: Does your company monitor electricity usage?
questionTextId: Apakah perusahaan Anda mencatat dan memantau penggunaan listrik secara berkala?
whyWeAsk: Monitoring electricity is the first step in reducing your carbon footprint and identifying operational inefficiencies.
whyWeAskId: Memantau pemakaian listrik adalah langkah awal memotong biaya tagihan energi dan menghitung jejak karbon operasional.

recommendedAction.title: Establish Electricity Usage Baseline
recommendedAction.description: Set up a simple monthly log for main electricity meters to track kilowatt-hour trends and identify peak usage hours.
recommendedAction.descriptionId: Buat catatan log kWh bulanan dan identifikasi jam pemakaian listrik puncak untuk efisiensi energi operasional.

recommendedModule.title: ESG 101: Practical ESG for Vendor Success
recommendedModule.titleId: ESG 101: Panduan Praktis Memulai ESG bagi Mitra Vendor
recommendedModule.description: Understand how simple, everyday actions create real value for your business and cut electricity costs.
recommendedModule.descriptionId: Pelajari langkah praktis memangkas tagihan listrik dan inefisiensi harian tanpa biaya sertifikasi mahal.
recommendedModule.reason: Recommended because electricity monitoring was identified as an improvement area.
recommendedModule.reasonId: Disarankan karena pemantauan konsumsi listrik Anda belum optimal.

questionTextId: Apakah Anda sudah menerapkan praktik efisiensi energi (seperti lampu hemat energi / SOP hemat listrik)?
whyWeAsk: Simple practices like LED retrofits, motion sensors, or turning off unused equipment reduce utility expenses and carbon emissions.
whyWeAskId: Langkah sederhana seperti konversi lampu LED atau SOP matikan alat saat tidak dipakai memangkas tagihan listrik hingga 20%.

recommendedAction.title: Switch to LED Lighting & Motion Sensors
recommendedAction.titleId: Konversi Lampu Hemat Energi LED & Sensor Gerak
recommendedAction.description: Retrofit standard fluorescent bulbs with energy-efficient LEDs and install motion sensors in less frequent areas.
recommendedAction.descriptionId: Ganti lampu neon konvensional dengan LED hemat daya dan pasang sensor otomatis pada ruangan jarang terpakai.

recommendedModule.title: Green Logistics: Fuel Efficiency & Route Optimization
recommendedModule.titleId: Logistik Hijau: Optimasi Rute Pengiriman & Penghematan BBM
recommendedModule.description: Practical route batching, tire pressure standards, and idling reductions that cut delivery fuel costs by 15-25%.
recommendedModule.descriptionId: Optimasi rute armada pengiriman obat/logistik, kontrol tekanan ban, dan zero-idling untuk hemat BBM.
recommendedModule.reason: Recommended to boost energy efficiency and fuel savings across operations.
recommendedModule.reasonId: Disarankan untuk meningkatkan efisiensi energi dan memotong biaya BBM armada.

questionTextId: Apakah perusahaan Anda memilah sampah organik, anorganik, dan sampah daur ulang?
whyWeAsk: Separating waste diverts valuable materials from landfills, lowers disposal costs, and supports circular economy goals.
whyWeAskId: Pemilahan sampah dari hulu mencegah penumpukan sampah di TPA, mengurangi biaya retribusi, dan mendukung ekonomi sirkular.

recommendedAction.title: Implement Waste Segregation & Bins
recommendedAction.titleId: Penerapan Pemilahan Sampah & Tempat Sampah Terpilah
recommendedAction.description: Place color-coded bins for organic, recyclable, and general waste in key operational areas.
recommendedAction.descriptionId: Sediakan tempat sampah terpilah dengan kode warna (Organik vs Anorganik) di seluruh area operasional.

recommendedModule.title: Food Waste & Eco-Packaging for Catering Partners
recommendedModule.titleId: Pengurangan Limbah Makanan & Kemasan Ramah Lingkungan untuk Katering
recommendedModule.description: Transitioning to biodegradable food containers, portion control, and organic waste composting in healthcare.
recommendedModule.descriptionId: Panduan beralih ke wadah biodegradable food-grade, pemilahan dapur, dan pengolahan limbah organik sirkular.
recommendedModule.reason: Recommended because waste segregation practices need enhancement.
recommendedModule.reasonId: Disarankan untuk memperkuat sistem pemilahan sampah dan kemasan ramah lingkungan.

questionText: Do you have initiatives to reduce single-use plastic?
questionTextId: Apakah ada inisiatif untuk mengurangi plastik sekali pakai atau beralih ke kemasan ramah lingkungan?
whyWeAsk: Minimizing single-use plastics reduces environmental pollution and aligns with growing customer and buyer compliance demands.
whyWeAskId: Mengurangi plastik sekali pakai menekan polusi mikroplastik dan memenuhi syarat kepatuhan mitra pengadaan Siloam.

recommendedAction.title: Single-Use Plastic Reduction & Eco-Packaging
recommendedAction.titleId: Pengurangan Plastik Sekali Pakai & Kemasan Hijau
recommendedAction.description: Replace disposable plastic packaging with biodegradable or reusable alternatives in deliveries.
recommendedAction.descriptionId: Beralih dari kantong plastik & styrofoam ke wadah food-grade berbahan ampas tebu (bagasse) atau kraft ramah lingkungan.

recommendedModule.title: Food Waste & Eco-Packaging for Catering Partners
recommendedModule.titleId: Pengurangan Limbah Makanan & Kemasan Ramah Lingkungan untuk Katering
recommendedModule.description: Practical guide to phasing out single-use plastics with certified compostable alternatives.
recommendedModule.descriptionId: Panduan eliminasi kemasan plastik sekali pakai dan beralih ke kemasan ramah lingkungan terstandarisasi.
recommendedModule.reason: Recommended to help phase out single-use plastics.
recommendedModule.reasonId: Disarankan untuk membantu transisi penggantian plastik sekali pakai.

questionTextId: Apakah perusahaan Anda memantau konsumsi air atau memiliki upaya konservasi air?
whyWeAsk: Tracking water consumption helps spot hidden leaks early, conserve local water resources, and optimize utility spending.
whyWeAskId: Pencatatan meteran air mendeteksi kebocoran pipa tersembunyi sejak dini dan menjaga kelestarian sumber daya air.

recommendedAction.title: Water Auditing & Aerator Installation
recommendedAction.titleId: Audit Kebocoran Air & Pemasangan Aerator Kran
recommendedAction.description: Install low-flow aerators on taps and inspect primary plumbing lines for unseen leaks.
recommendedAction.descriptionId: Pasang aerator hemat air pada kran wastafel dan lakukan inspeksi berkala mencegah kebocoran tersembunyi.

questionText: Does your company provide employee health and safety training?
questionTextId: Apakah perusahaan Anda mengadakan pelatihan K3 (Kesehatan & Keselamatan Kerja) untuk karyawan?
whyWeAsk: Regular health and safety training reduces workplace injuries, protects employee wellbeing, and ensures labor standard compliance.
whyWeAskId: Pelatihan K3 rutin mencegah kecelakaan kerja hingga 80%, melindungi pekerja, dan memenuhi syarat audit rumah sakit.

recommendedAction.title: Workplace Safety (K3) Training & PPE Standard
recommendedAction.description: Conduct regular safety briefing (Toolbox Talk) and ensure certified PPE usage across field operations.
recommendedAction.descriptionId: Gelar briefing K3 rutin 3-menit awal shift dan lengkapi pekerja dengan APD standar keselamatan rumah sakit.

recommendedModule.title: Occupational Health & Safety (K3) for Facility & Cleaning
recommendedModule.titleId: K3 & Keselamatan Kerja untuk Mitra Jasa Kebersihan & Fasilitas
recommendedModule.description: Standardized PPE protocols, ergonomic chemical handling, and slip-fall prevention in healthcare facilities.
recommendedModule.descriptionId: Protokol APD standar rumah sakit, penanganan aman bahan kimia (MSDS), dan pencegahan kecelakaan kerja.
recommendedModule.reason: Recommended because employee safety training was marked for improvement.
recommendedModule.reasonId: Disarankan karena pelatihan K3 pekerja Anda perlu diperkuat.

questionTextId: Apakah karyawan mendapatkan fasilitas jaminan kesehatan atau dukungan kesejahteraan (seperti BPJS/asuransi)?
whyWeAsk: Providing health coverage, mental health resources, or flexible scheduling improves workforce retention and team morale.
whyWeAskId: Jaminan perlindungan kesehatan meningkatkan produktivitas, menurunkan angka absensi sakit, dan menjaga loyalitas tim.

recommendedAction.title: Employee Wellbeing & Health Coverage
recommendedAction.description: Ensure full enrollment in health insurance / BPJS and introduce ergonomic workplace assessments.
recommendedAction.descriptionId: Pastikan seluruh staf terlindungi BPJS Kesehatan & Ketenagakerjaan serta periksa kenyamanan ergonomi kerja.

recommendedModule.title: Occupational Health & Safety (K3) for Facility & Cleaning
recommendedModule.titleId: K3 & Keselamatan Kerja untuk Mitra Jasa Kebersihan & Fasilitas
recommendedModule.description: Practical daily safety routines and employee wellbeing protocols that ensure accident-free shifts.
recommendedModule.descriptionId: Prosedur keselamatan kerja harian (Toolbox Talk) dan jaminan perlindungan pekerja lapangan.
recommendedModule.reason: Recommended to protect team wellbeing and health standards.
recommendedModule.reasonId: Disarankan untuk meningkatkan standar perlindungan kesehatan tim kerja Anda.

questionText: Does your company participate in community programs?
questionTextId: Apakah perusahaan Anda aktif dalam program sosial masyarakat atau kegiatan CSR lokal?
whyWeAsk: Engaging with local communities through volunteering, local hiring, or donations builds trust and strong social capital.
whyWeAskId: Keterlibatan sosial dan kepedulian komunitas sekitar membangun reputasi positif dan kepercayaan publik.

recommendedAction.title: Launch a Community Engagement Program
recommendedAction.description: Partner with local community groups, prioritize local hiring, or sponsor community health initiatives.
recommendedAction.descriptionId: Bekerja sama dengan kelompok warga lokal, memprioritaskan rekrutmen sekitar, atau bakti sosial kesehatan.

questionText: Does your company provide employee development or training?
questionTextId: Apakah ada program peningkatan keterampilan, pelatihan berkala, atau pengembangan karier staf?
whyWeAsk: Investing in skill development and career growth boosts productivity and fosters a loyal, resilient team.
whyWeAskId: Investasi pada pelatihan staf meningkatkan mutu hasil kerja dan daya saing operasional perusahaan.

recommendedAction.title: Structured Employee Development Plan
recommendedAction.description: Offer annual skill development stipends or structured internal mentoring workshops for your team.
recommendedAction.descriptionId: Sediakan modul pelatihan peningkatan keahlian kerja teknis dan sertifikasi kompetensi berkala bagi staf.

questionText: Are working hours and fair compensation policies clearly defined?
questionTextId: Apakah jam kerja, upah lembur, dan kebijakan kompensasi yang adil diatur secara tertulis?
whyWeAsk: Clear wage, overtime, and working hour guidelines establish a respectful, equitable, and legally compliant workplace culture.
whyWeAskId: Pedoman upah dan jam kerja yang jelas menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang bermartabat dan taat regulasi ketenagakerjaan.

recommendedAction.title: Formalize Fair Compensation & Overtime Guidelines
recommendedAction.titleId: Pedoman Kebijakan Upah & Jam Kerja Adil
recommendedAction.description: Publish clear employee handbook terms regarding wage scales, standard hours, and overtime compensation.
recommendedAction.descriptionId: Tetapkan dokumen tertulis mengenai skala upah UMR, jam kerja manusiawi, dan kompensasi lembur transparan.

questionText: Does your company have a Code of Conduct?
questionTextId: Apakah perusahaan Anda memiliki Kode Etik (Code of Conduct) dan SOP integritas bisnis tertulis?
whyWeAsk: A written code of conduct sets clear behavioral expectations for ethical business operations and employee interactions.
whyWeAskId: Kode Etik tertulis menjadi pedoman operasional agar seluruh karyawan menjunjung tinggi kejujuran dan profesionalisme.

recommendedAction.title: Draft Company Code of Conduct
recommendedAction.titleId: Penyusunan Kode Etik & SOP Integritas Bisnis
recommendedAction.description: Formalize written business ethics principles covering fair treatment, integrity, and compliance expectations.
recommendedAction.descriptionId: Susun dokumen resmi Kode Etik Perusahaan yang memuat prinsip integritas, keadilan, dan anti-diskriminasi.

recommendedModule.title: Data Privacy & Anti-Corruption in Healthcare Supply Chain
recommendedModule.titleId: Perlindungan Data Pribadi (UU PDP) & Pakta Integritas Bebas Gratifikasi
recommendedModule.description: Ensuring zero-tolerance anti-bribery practices, medical vendor ethics, and personal data protection compliance.
recommendedModule.descriptionId: Penerapan pakta integritas tender tanpa suap/gratifikasi, tata kelola data rekam medis rekanan, dan UU PDP.
recommendedModule.reason: Recommended to formalize business ethics and compliance policies.
recommendedModule.reasonId: Disarankan untuk memperkuat tata kelola kepatuhan dan integritas bisnis.

questionTextId: Apakah seluruh karyawan memahami komitmen anti-penyuapan, bebas gratifikasi, dan pakta integritas tender?
whyWeAsk: Clear anti-corruption guidelines prevent financial misconduct and protect your business reputation during partner audits.
whyWeAskId: Komitmen bebas gratifikasi melindungi perusahaan dari risiko sanksi hukum dan diskualifikasi kemitraan.

recommendedAction.title: Anti-Bribery & Corruption Policy
recommendedAction.description: Implement zero-tolerance anti-bribery policies and communicate clear gift-receiving thresholds.
recommendedAction.descriptionId: Terapkan kebijakan toleransi nol terhadap suap, komisi tidak resmi, atau pemberian hadiah kepada tim pengadaan.

recommendedModule.title: Data Privacy & Anti-Corruption in Healthcare Supply Chain
recommendedModule.titleId: Perlindungan Data Pribadi (UU PDP) & Pakta Integritas Bebas Gratifikasi
recommendedModule.description: Anti-bribery protocols and tender integrity compliance for Siloam healthcare suppliers.
recommendedModule.descriptionId: Protokol pencegahan gratifikasi dan kepatuhan pakta integritas tender pengadaan rumah sakit.
recommendedModule.reason: Recommended to ensure strict anti-corruption safeguards.
recommendedModule.reasonId: Disarankan untuk memastikan pemahaman komitmen anti-penyuapan.

questionText: Is there a mechanism to report unethical behavior?
questionTextId: Apakah tersedia saluran pengaduan rahasia (whistleblowing) untuk melaporkan pelanggaran etika?
whyWeAsk: Confidential reporting channels or suggestion boxes enable early detection of compliance issues before they escalate.
whyWeAskId: Saluran pengaduan aman membantu mendeteksi penyimpangan internal sejak dini tanpa risiko intimidasi.

recommendedAction.title: Establish Confidential Whistleblowing Channel
recommendedAction.description: Set up an anonymous email or box for staff to safely report ethical concerns without fear of retaliation.
recommendedAction.descriptionId: Sediakan kotak saran atau email khusus rahasia untuk pelaporan pelanggaran tanpa risiko pembalasan.

questionText: Does your company have basic data privacy practices?
questionTextId: Apakah perusahaan Anda menerapkan perlindungan data privasi (UU PDP) dan keamanan informasi?
whyWeAsk: Safeguarding customer and employee personal data protects against cyber breaches and builds stakeholder trust.
whyWeAskId: Perlindungan data rekanan dan pasien rumah sakit wajib sesuai UU PDP No. 27/2022 demi mencegah kebocoran informasi.

recommendedAction.title: Basic Data Privacy & Security Controls (UU PDP)
recommendedAction.titleId: Tata Kelola Perlindungan Data Pribadi (UU PDP)
recommendedAction.description: Enforce multi-factor authentication, secure password policies, and employee data privacy awareness.
recommendedAction.descriptionId: Terapkan enkripsi data, password aman, dan kepatuhan UU PDP No. 27/2022 atas seluruh data pasien dan rekanan.

recommendedModule.title: Data Privacy & Anti-Corruption in Healthcare Supply Chain
recommendedModule.titleId: Perlindungan Data Pribadi (UU PDP) & Pakta Integritas Bebas Gratifikasi
recommendedModule.description: Understanding Personal Data Protection (UU PDP No. 27/2022) requirements in vendor partnerships.
recommendedModule.descriptionId: Pemahaman kepatuhan hukum UU PDP No. 27/2022 atas keamanan data pasien dan rekanan Siloam.
recommendedModule.reason: Recommended to comply with national data privacy standards (UU PDP).
recommendedModule.reasonId: Disarankan untuk mematuhi regulasi perlindungan data pribadi UU PDP.

questionText: Does your company communicate ethical expectations to suppliers?
questionTextId: Apakah Anda menyosialisasikan standar etika dan kepatuhan ESG kepada sub-vendor / pemasok Anda?
whyWeAsk: Extending ethical standards to partners ensures supply chain integrity and reduces third-party operational risk.
whyWeAskId: Penyelarasan standar etika kepada mitra sub-kontraktor menjamin integritas seluruh rantai pasok rumah sakit.

recommendedAction.title: Implement Supplier Code of Conduct
recommendedAction.description: Standardize ethical, labor, and environmental expectations for key commercial suppliers and partners.
recommendedAction.descriptionId: Sosialisasikan standar integritas dan kepatuhan ESG kepada mitra sub-kontraktor dan distributor Anda.
